model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the changes in the absolute mean of the hidden state across different layers. 

The X-axis is labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 22, with numerical labels at intervals of 5. The Y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean", has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 4, with numerical labels at intervals of 1.

The graph contains three lines, each representing different data. The blue dashed line represents the "hidden state mean before gate", the red dotted line represents the "hidden state mean after gate", and the green solid line represents the "hidden state mean of baseline". The blue dashed line starts at approximately 0 at layer 0, increases gradually to around 0.25 at layer 5, remains relatively stable until layer 15, and then sharply increases to 4 at layer 22. The red dotted line and the green solid line remain relatively stable and close to 0 throughout the layers, with the red dotted line having an average value of 0.05 and the green solid line having an average value of 0.04. The average value of the blue dashed line is 0.71. 

Overall, the graph provides a visual representation of how the absolute mean of the hidden state changes across different layers for the three different representations.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图展示了三个不同指标在多个网络层上的绝对均值（Abs Mean）。X轴标记为“层”，具有线性刻度，范围从0到20，均匀间隔为5。Y轴标记为“绝对均值”，具有线性刻度，范围从0到4，均匀间隔为1。该图包含三条线：一条蓝色虚线，代表“门控前的隐藏状态均值，平均0.71”，从（0，-0.1）开始，在第10层之前保持相对稳定在0.25左右，然后在第20层急剧上升到4.2；一条红色点线，代表“门控后的隐藏状态均值，平均0.05”，从（0，0）开始，在整个x轴范围内保持在0左右；还有一条绿色实线，代表“基线的隐藏状态均值，平均0.04”，从（0，0）开始，同样保持在0左右。
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers, comparing three distinct scenarios. The x-axis represents the layer number, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 22, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the absolute mean, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 4, and tick labels at intervals of 1. Three lines are depicted: the blue dashed line represents the hidden state mean before the gate, starting at approximately 0.1 at layer 0 and increasing to around 4.2 at layer 22; the red dotted line represents the hidden state mean after the gate, remaining relatively stable around 0.05 across all layers; and the green solid line represents the hidden state mean of the baseline, also remaining relatively stable around 0.04 across all layers. The blue dashed line exhibits a notable increase from layer 18 to 22, while the other two lines remain relatively flat throughout.
model_annotations.German: This diagram represents the hidden state mean across different layers of a neural network model, comparing three distinct metrics: the hidden state mean before gate, the hidden state mean after gate, and the hidden state mean of the baseline. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", is linearly scaled and ranges from 0 to 22, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean", is also linearly scaled, ranging from 0 to 4, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line represents the hidden state mean before gate, starting at approximately 0 at Layer 0 and ending at approximately 4.25 at Layer 22, with a sharp increase between Layer 18 and Layer 22. The red dotted line represents the hidden state mean after gate, remaining relatively stable around 0 throughout the layers, with values ranging from approximately 0 to 0.1. The green solid line represents the hidden state mean of the baseline, also remaining relatively stable around 0, with values ranging from approximately 0 to 0.1, closely following the trend of the red dotted line.
